claim: Sam's Club and Costco - Which one is better? : r/samsclub - Reddit
summary: Sam’s Club membership is cheaper, they offers Scan & Go, Curbside Pickup (free for Plus Members), Online price is same as club, Free Shipping for Plus members “on most items”, real-time store inventory information available online/app. They are open longer hours and open earlier (7am) for Plus members only.
